headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Fellow Stagg kettles. See the [README](https://github.com/Willmac16/homebridge-kettle#readme) for setup instructions.

url.title: Base URL
url.description: Wi-Fi: base URL of the kettle (no trailing slash). BLE: base URL of the bridge.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Native API only: how often the kettle's state is read in the background. HomeKit is answered from the last reading.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth (on/off)
bluetooth.description: Native API only. Firmware 1.2.26 can only be switched on or off over Bluetooth, which Homebridge reaches through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy near the kettle (`bluetooth_proxy:` with `active: true`). While that link is up it also gives live readings during heating, when the kettle's Wi-Fi is off. Leave the proxy empty to stay on Wi-Fi only.

proxy.title: ESPHome Bluetooth proxy
proxy.description: Host name or IP address of the ESPHome device running bluetooth_proxy.

encryptionKey.title: API encryption key
encryptionKey.description: The proxy's `api: encryption: key:` (base64), if it has one.

address.title: Kettle Bluetooth address
address.description: Optional. Without it the first kettle the proxy sees (named EKG-…) is used, and its address is logged so you can pin it here.

minTemp.title: Minimum Temperature (°C)
minTemp.description: Lowest target temperature exposed to HomeKit.

maxTemp.title: Maximum Temperature (°C)
maxTemp.description: Highest target temperature exposed to HomeKit.
